description: All-ground one-way Poisson layer built on the qualified electron particle + electron-energy diffusion baseline.
objective: Add a solved electrostatic potential without yet feeding the electric field back into electron transport, so Poisson construction and charge response are isolated.
target_claims: electron particle and electron-energy diffusion remain unchanged from the qualified energy baseline
Poisson solves from rho_q=e*(n_i,frozen-n_e) on the real ICP RZ plasma geometry
all boundaries of the plasma subdomain are grounded at phi=0 V
Poisson remains one-way: no electrostatic drift, Joule heating, or solved-potential sheath feedback
constraints: electron particle continuity solved in log-molar form
electron energy density solved as c_epsilon in eV mol/m^3
electron particle and energy transport identical to electron-diffusion-energy-experiment
frozen positive number-density background is spatially uniform and not evolved
phi=0 V on the complete plasma-subdomain boundary
Poisson-to-wall-collection feedback disabled; electron wall closures continue to use zero_phi
observations: plasma potential min/max and final profile
